name: LensVision Reflex R7
description: The LensVision Reflex R7 is a feature-packed DSLR designed for the passionate enthusiast. It bridges the gap between entry-level models and full-frame professional bodies, offering advanced capabilities in a durable and ergonomic package. The 32.5MP APS-C sensor delivers outstanding resolution, giving you ample room for cropping while maintaining excellent detail. A key feature is the Dual Pixel CMOS AF system, which provides fast and accurate autofocus during live view shooting and video recording, a significant advantage over traditional DSLR systems. The R7 can shoot action sequences at up to 10fps, making it capable for sports and wildlife. It also boasts a weather-sealed body, dual control dials for efficient setting changes, and a top LCD panel for at-a-glance information. This camera is built for photographers who are ready to push their creative boundaries and need a tool that can keep up with their growing skills and ambitions. Features: 32.5MP APS-C CMOS Sensor, Dual Pixel CMOS AF for Live View and Video, 10 fps Continuous Shooting, Weather-sealed construction, Articulating Touchscreen and Top LCD Panel. Advantages: High-resolution sensor provides great detail; Excellent autofocus performance, especially in live view; Robust build quality and good ergonomics. Considerations: 4K video has a significant crop; Single memory card slot. Best for: Serious hobbyists and enthusiast photographers looking for a high-performance APS-C DSLR.
